name: ziwei-doushu
description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
one_liner: An open-source engine for Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology chart system, plus a massive dataset of pre-written readings — it calculates your 'chart' from your birth date/time and can explain what it traditionally means.
buyer: A Chinese-language app or content creator building a fortune-telling or astrology product who wants a correct, well-researched calculation engine instead of building the astrology math themselves.
business_use_cases: A Chinese astrology app uses the free engine and licensed dataset as its backend instead of paying a specialist to build the calculation logic.
A content creator builds a 'daily reading' social account or mini-app using the engine to generate personalized posts for followers.
A matchmaking or relationship app in Chinese-speaking markets adds a 'compatibility chart' feature as a differentiator using this engine.

money_ideas.idea: A paid consumer app offering personalized readings, charging for deeper reports beyond a free basic chart.
A subscription for ongoing yearly/monthly fortune updates tied to a user's saved chart.

steal_this: Wrap the engine in a simple web form that takes a birthdate and spits out a free basic chart plus a paid 'full reading' PDF — a clear weekend-buildable product for Chinese-speaking markets.
